english.title: Provide early / later years provision when registration suspended
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 69(9) and (10) of the Childcare Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being registered under Ch. 2 / 3 of the early years / general childcare register
without reasonable excuse provided
early/later years childminding (for child under 8) when registration suspended OR
early/later years provision on premises (for child under 8) when registration in respect of the premises
was suspended in accordance with regs. under s. 69 of the Act

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence no longer applies after the 31st October 2024 due to changes made by the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023. For the offence applying after this date, see H101875.
(ii) Section 69(5) and (8) of the Childcare Act 2006 provides that the offence does not apply in relation to early or later years childminding and early or later years provision which the person may provide without being registered under Chapter 2 or 3.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months from the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to warrant the proceedings comes to his knowledge, but no more than three years after the commission of the offence.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
